name: build
label: Build Project
description: Build a project from requirements to working code with git-tracked progress.

orchestrator.description: Coordinates the build — delegates steps, reviews reports, advances gates

developer.description: Writes code, runs tests, commits changes

reviewer.description: Reviews code quality and requirement coverage

steps.label: Project Setup
steps.description: Initialize the project: create directory structure, install dependencies, set up build tooling, create initial files. Commit the scaffolding as the first commit.

steps.label: Core Implementation
steps.description: Build the primary functionality described in the brief. Write tests for key behaviors. Commit working code.

steps.label: Polish & Ship
steps.description: Final touches: styling, error handling, README, any deployment configuration. Ensure everything builds and tests pass. Final commit.
